# Planetar (`monsters:planetar`)
*Large celestial, lawful good* | **CR** 16 (XP 15,000; PB +5)
**AC** 19 | **HP** 262 (21d10 + 147) | **Speed** 40 ft., fly 120 ft., hover True
**STR** 24 (+7) | **DEX** 20 (+5) | **CON** 24 (+7) | **INT** 19 (+4) | **WIS** 22 (+6) | **CHA** 25 (+7)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: STR](../proficiencies/saving-throw-str.md) +12, [Saving Throw: CON](../proficiencies/saving-throw-con.md) +12, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +11, [Saving Throw: CHA](../proficiencies/saving-throw-cha.md) +12
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +11
**Damage Resistances:** radiant
**Condition Immunities:** [Charmed](../conditions/charmed.md), [Exhaustion](../conditions/exhaustion.md), [Frightened](../conditions/frightened.md)
**Senses:** Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 21
**Languages:** All; telepathy 120 ft.

## Traits
- **Divine Awareness.** The planetar knows if it hears a lie.
- **Exalted Restoration.** If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.
- **Magic Resistance.** The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.
- **Radiant Sword.** Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.
- **Holy Burst.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.
- **Spellcasting.** The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
  - At will: [Detect Evil and Good](../spells/detect-evil-and-good.md) (level 1)
  - 1/day: [Commune](../spells/commune.md) (level 5), [Control Weather](../spells/control-weather.md) (level 8), [Dispel Evil and Good](../spells/dispel-evil-and-good.md) (level 5), [Raise Dead](../spells/raise-dead.md) (level 5)

## Bonus Actions
- **Divine Aid (2/day).** The planetar casts Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
  - Other: [Cure Wounds](../spells/cure-wounds.md) (level 1), [Invisibility](../spells/invisibility.md) (level 2), [Lesser Restoration](../spells/lesser-restoration.md) (level 2), [Remove Curse](../spells/remove-curse.md) (level 3)
